name: Disaar SPF90 Oil-Free Sunscreen Cream 40g | Instant Protection UVA UVB Foundation PA+++
description:
Disaar SPF90 Max Oil-Free Sunscreen Protection Cream 40g | Made in China

Get maximum sun protection with Disaar SPF90 Max Oil-Free Sunscreen Cream. Designed for adults, this high-SPF cream shields your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays while keeping it oil-free and fresh. Ideal for daily use, it offers effective UV defense without leaving a greasy residue.

Key Features:

SPF Rating: SPF 90 for superior sun protection

Formulation: Oil-free cream, suitable for daily use

Function: Broad-spectrum UV protection

Ingredient: Mineral-based for safe and effective coverage

Age Group: Adults

Capacity: 40g

Brand: Disaar

Origin: China

Supply Type: OBM (Original Brand Manufacturing)

Protect your skin from sun damage, tanning, and premature aging with Disaar SPF90 Max Oil-Free Sunscreen Cream.
